messages.subject: max_correction = 25.83 >= 25.00, so 'vb.correction' is aborted
parts:
Hello 

can you pls help with error?

I have this code for Type IV:

formula <- Y ~ 1 + tmean_summer + tmean_fall + ppt_fall + pdsi_summer + pdsi_winter + ppt_summer + ppt_spring + ppt_winter+
  f(countyid, model='bym2', graph=county.adj, hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(1,0.01)), phi = list(prior = 'pc', param = c(0.5, 0.5)))) +
  f(year, model='rw2', hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(1,0.01)))) +
  f(year2, model="iid") +
  f(ID.area.int,model="besag", graph=county.adj, group=ID.year.int, control.group=list(model="rw2"))


############# Run the model ##############
outputbj_iv <- inla(formula,family="poisson",data=as.list(datam,Y,E),E=E,
control.predictor=list(link=1,compute=TRUE),  control.compute=list(config=TRUE,dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo=TRUE, openmp.strategy="huge"), control.mode=list(theta=c(1.625973,1.449922, 1.741843, 1.112716, 1.112716), restart=TRUE), control.inla = list(strategy = "gaussian",int.strategy="eb"),verbose=FALSE, num.threads = detectCores())


ERROR: 

*** max_correction = 25.83 >= 25.00, so 'vb.correction' is aborted
*** Please (re-)consider your model, priors, confounding, etc.
*** You can change the emergency value (current value=25.00) by
*** 'control.inla=list(control.vb=list(emergency=...))'
